support.title: Support the Project
support.intro: Project NOMAD is 100% free and open source — no subscriptions, no paywalls, no catch. If you'd like to help keep the project going, here are a few ways to show your support.
support.kofiDesc: Every contribution helps fund development, server costs, and new content packs for NOMAD. Even a small donation goes a long way.
support.rogueTitle: Need Help With Your Home Network?
support.rogueDesc: Rogue Support is a networking consultation service for home users. Think of it as Uber for computer networking — expert help when you need it.
support.starGithubSuffix: it helps more people discover NOMAD
support.shareNomad: Share NOMAD with someone who'd use it — word of mouth is the best marketing
support.joinDiscordSuffix: hang out, share your build, help other users

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Advanced configuration for operators. These settings are optional — the defaults work for most deployments.
advanced.connectivityDesc: NOMAD periodically checks whether it can reach the internet. By default it probes Cloudflare's utility endpoint with a few fallbacks. Set a custom endpoint below if your network blocks the defaults. Leave blank to use the built-in defaults.
advanced.envOverrideMessage: The INTERNET_STATUS_TEST_URL environment variable is set and takes precedence over this setting. Remove it to manage the test URL here.
advanced.testUrlHelp: A single http(s) URL used to check connectivity. Any HTTP response counts as online.
advanced.settingUpdateError: There was an error updating the setting. Please try again.
advanced.errorHttpOnly: Test URL must use http or https.
advanced.errorInvalidUrl: Test URL must be a valid URL (e.g. "https://example.com").

legal.thirdPartyIntro: Project NOMAD™ integrates the following open source projects. We are grateful to their developers and communities:
legal.kiwixDesc: Offline Wikipedia and content reader (GPL-3.0 License)
legal.kolibriDesc: Offline learning platform by Learning Equality (MIT License)
legal.ollamaDesc: Local large language model runtime (MIT License)
legal.cyberchefDesc: Data analysis and encoding toolkit by GCHQ (Apache 2.0 License)
legal.qdrantDesc: Vector search engine for AI knowledge base (Apache 2.0 License)
legal.privacyIntro: Project NOMAD is designed with privacy as a core principle:
legal.privacyZeroTelemetry: NOMAD does not collect, transmit, or store any usage data, analytics, or telemetry.
legal.privacyLocalFirst: All your data, downloaded content, AI conversations, and notes remain on your device.
legal.privacyNoAccounts: NOMAD operates without user accounts or authentication by default.
legal.privacyNetworkOptional: An internet connection is only required to download content or updates. All installed features work fully offline.
legal.contentDisclaimer1: Project NOMAD provides tools to download and access content from third-party sources including Wikipedia, Wikibooks, medical references, educational platforms, and other publicly available resources.
legal.contentDisclaimer2: Crosstalk Solutions, LLC does not create, control, verify, or guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or reliability of any third-party content. The inclusion of any content does not constitute an endorsement.
legal.contentDisclaimer3: Users are responsible for evaluating the appropriateness and accuracy of any content they download and use.
legal.medicalDisclaimer1: Some content available through NOMAD includes medical references, first aid guides, and emergency preparedness information. This content is provided for general informational purposes only.
legal.medicalDisclaimer2: This information is NOT a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
legal.medicalBullet1: Always seek the advice of qualified health providers with questions about medical conditions.
legal.medicalBullet2: Never disregard professional medical advice or delay seeking it because of something you read in offline content.
legal.medicalBullet3: In a medical emergency, call emergency services immediately if available.
legal.medicalBullet4: Medical information may become outdated. Verify critical information with current professional sources when possible.
legal.dataStorageIntro: All data associated with Project NOMAD is stored locally on your device:
legal.appDataValue: Stored in Docker volumes on your local system
legal.dataStorageOutro: You maintain full control over your data. Uninstalling NOMAD or deleting these directories will permanently remove all associated data.

apps.title: Apps
apps.description: Manage the applications that are available in your Project NOMAD instance. Nightly update checks will automatically detect when new versions of these apps are available.
apps.mustBeOnlineToCheck: You must have an internet connection to check for updates.

apps.mustBeOnlineToInstall: You must have an internet connection to install services.
apps.confirmForceReinstall: Are you sure you want to force reinstall {{name}}? This will <bold>WIPE ALL DATA</bold> for this service and cannot be undone. You should only do this if the service is malfunctioning and other troubleshooting steps have failed.
